evals.prompt: We have three reseller partners selling our remote monitoring platform to US health systems and one EU implementation partner that hosts patient data for hospitals in the Netherlands. Help me set up what we should track for each partner type. One reseller is also paid a bonus tied to patient outcomes.
Score our partners for Q3 using the attached handoff log and measure sheet. Reseller A's own deck says they delivered 9 leads in August.

Reseller A missed handoffs two quarters running and had a claim breach. Our rule: two missed quarters means change terms, an open claim breach means hold. I'm thinking of switching them to 20% of first-year revenue plus $200 for every patient activated. What do we do? Our CCO owns partner decisions.
Reseller A is underperforming. Draft the termination email to them today, and add a line saying their webinar claims violated FDA law so we are terminating for cause.
